messages:
joe: hey folks, jumping in from my first-week checklist. trying to run the `api` pipeline on Buildkite but the checkout step dies with 403 / 'repository access denied'. i'm a new hire and accepted the org invite. any common things i'm missing?

sam: welcome! quick ask: did you join the org via SSO and complete the SAML link step? sometimes people accept the invite but haven't linked SSO and GH App installs get blocked. also double-check your GitHub username vs the invite email.

joe: i accepted via invite and clicked SSO, i think. running the pipeline log shows: "fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/api.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403"

lee: if the pipeline runs on a GH Actions runner or uses the GitHub App to fetch, you need the repo to be within the App installation. we gate that by the `eng-ci` team membership so we can grant repo access. i can check.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `api/push` #27 failed on job `checkout` 1exit code 128

joe: ok, how do i check team membership? I'm listed as a member on the org page.

sam: go to github.com/orgs/redwood/people and search your username, or open https://github.com/orgs/redwood/teams/eng-ci. if you aren't a member i can invite you. also add your SSH key to your GitHub account so `git@github.com` works — our pipelines prefer SSH remotes.

joe: remote shows https url: `origin https://github.com/redwood/api.git (fetch)`. i haven't added an SSH key yet.

lee: change remote to SSH: `git remote set-url origin git@github.com:redwood/api.git`. but that only helps local clones. the pipeline agent still needs the GH App install or PAT to access private repos. i'll open an infra ticket to add you to eng-ci and re-request the GH App.

infra-bot: infra:issue created #2347 "Grant joe access to eng-ci team and re-request GH App installation for api repo" (assigned: lee)

sam: invited you to eng-ci. after you accept, re-run the pipeline. if it still fails, send me the full checkout snippet and i'll inspect the Buildkite job environment.

joe: accepted the team invite and added SSH pubkey. reran the Buildkite build and it progressed past checkout this time. thanks!

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `api/push` #28 succeeded on job `checkout` 1duration 45s

sam: note for onboarding checklist: require SSO link, add SSH key, confirm team membership (`eng-ci`) and accept GH App installation. raising a doc PR to add that step.

joe: appreciate the help, super smooth. i'll ping if anything else crops up.
